column1: # Original DICE Pin Pong, DIP 6 (1 coin / 1 credit, free ball disabled, 5 balls). A coin and Start
# (500, 1500 ms) begin the game. Recorded closed-loop play (2000-20000 ms); then the flippers rest and
# Start serves each lost ball until the fifth is gone and the game ends; Start without a credit after
# the end (70000 ms) does not restart.
